mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate citalopram's risk of QT prolongation and SIADH; citalopram may inhibit CYP2D6 minimally affecting chlorthalidone metabolism, but electrolyte depletion is the primary concern.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; monitor ECG if QT prolongation risk factors present; consider potassium supplementation or alternative diuretic if electrolyte abnormalities develop.
